entities.name: Kathleen Martíne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kathleen Teresa Martínez Berry is a Dominican archaeologist, lawyer, and diplomat, best known for her work in search of the tomb of Cleopatra in Egypt. She heads the Egyptian-Dominican mission in Alexandria and is currently minister counselor in charge of cultural affairs at the Dominican embassy in Egypt.
